stories.title: Maybelline updates tagline
stories.summary: Maybelline has tweaked its long-standing tagline to be more inclusive and empowering. The brand is using ads featuring Miley Cyrus to capture this new spirit. Punctuation and phrasing have been adjusted to reflect evolving perceptions of beauty.

stories.title: Sabrina Carpenter stars in Johnnie Walker holiday ad
stories.summary: Sabrina Carpenter is the face of a new Johnnie Walker holiday campaign directed by Damien Chazelle. The ads lean on the brand's Keep Walking ethos and French New Wave cinema. A limited-edition co-branded bottle is launching across Europe, Australia, and North America.

stories.title: Nivea Soft targets Gen Z with new campaign
stories.summary: Nivea India has launched a campaign for Nivea Soft featuring Taapsee Pannu and Jannat Zubair. The ads aim to simplify skincare routines for younger consumers who may feel overwhelmed by trends. The company notes that skincare awareness is growing among the youth.

stories.title: Calvin Klein features Jungkook for holidays
stories.summary: Calvin Klein has unveiled its Holiday 2026 campaign featuring Jungkook of BTS. The brand continues its strategy of using global music icons to front its seasonal collections. The full piece is for subscribers.

stories.title: Campa Cola launches festive campaign
stories.summary: Campa Cola has released a festive campaign titled Tayyari Big, Tyohaar Bada Big. Conceptualised by McCann India, the ads focus on the preparation work behind celebrations rather than the final event. The brand positions itself as a companion during the cleaning and cooking process.

stories.title: David Schwimmer returns to red sweater in Quince ad
stories.summary: David Schwimmer is reprising his role as the man in the red sweater for a holiday commercial from lifestyle brand Quince. The 60-second spot references his character's famous paternity-reveal storyline from Friends. Nostalgia is now a holiday marketing strategy.

stories.title: PNG Jewellers unveils legacy campaign
stories.summary: PNG Jewellers has launched its Unstoppable Legacy campaign featuring Madhuri Dixit and Ranbir Kapoor. The brand continues to rely on high-profile celebrity partnerships for its marketing efforts. The full piece is for subscribers.

stories.title: Alia Bhatt fronts Malabar Gold campaign
stories.summary: Malabar Gold and Diamonds has featured Alia Bhatt in its latest campaign, Diamonds That Move With You. The brand is using the actor to promote its jewellery collection. The full piece is for subscribers.

stories.title: HP spotlights Indian innovations in Diwali ad
stories.summary: HP India has launched a campaign titled Lights of Change, highlighting six Indian innovations. The film features technology used for accessibility, healthcare, and environmental sustainability, including a self-learning Braille device. The company is positioning its hardware as a tool for solving everyday challenges.

stories.title: Jos Alukkas releases platinum jewellery ad
stories.summary: Jos Alukkas has rolled out a new advertisement for its platinum jewellery collection featuring brand ambassador Dulquer Salmaan. The company continues to use celebrity endorsements for its festive marketing. The full piece is for subscribers.

stories.title: Amazon India uses childhood memories for Diwali
stories.summary: Amazon India has launched a campaign titled #DeliverTheLove, focusing on sibling bonds and family reunions. The film features a man sending an empty glass bottle to his siblings to recall childhood memories. The company is framing its delivery service as a way to bridge distance.

stories.title: Tata Starbucks positions stores as family spaces
stories.summary: Tata Starbucks has launched a campaign titled Special Diwali ki Special Jagah. The coffee chain is positioning its outlets as settings for family connections and meaningful milestones rather than just places to buy beverages. The brand is attempting to turn coffeehouses into holiday destinations.

stories.title: Lufthansa Group appoints Omnicom Media
stories.summary: Lufthansa Group has appointed Omnicom Media as its global media agency of record. The decision follows a review of the company's media mandate. The full piece is for subscribers. Further details were thin in the open report.

stories.title: Big Bang Awards 2026 expands categories
stories.summary: The Advertising Club Bangalore has expanded the category framework for its 2026 awards. The new sections cover regional markets, performance marketing, and enterprise communications. The theme of the festival is Open Brief, intended to recognise creative work across various mediums and disciplines.

stories.title: Pernod Ricard appoints Initiative for APAC media
stories.summary: Pernod Ricard has appointed Initiative as its media agency partner across nine markets in India and the Asia-Pacific region. The move follows a competitive review, ending a two-decade partnership with Wavemaker in India and Singapore. The company thanked its former partner for its contributions.

stories.title: AMV BBDO joins American Express roster
stories.summary: AMV BBDO has won a place on the American Express agency roster. The appointment follows a review of the company's marketing partnerships. The full piece is for subscribers. Further details were thin in the open report.

stories.title: Pernod Ricard shifts media mandate to Initiative
stories.summary: Pernod Ricard has moved its media mandate for nine India and APAC markets to Initiative, an Omnicom Media agency. The appointment follows a competitive review, replacing Wavemaker after a twenty-year tenure. The company acknowledged Wavemaker's past work on campaigns like Royal Stag Boombox.

stories.title: Initiative wins Pernod Ricard media mandate
stories.summary: Pernod Ricard has appointed Initiative as its media agency for nine markets across India and the Asia-Pacific region. The agency takes over from Wavemaker, which held the account for two decades. The mandate follows a competitive review of the company's media strategy.

stories.title: Airtel appoints Vishwajeet Sinha as vice president of marketing
stories.summary: Vishwajeet Sinha has joined Airtel as vice president of marketing. Sinha previously held roles at Razorpay, Scapia and Meesho. He announced the move on LinkedIn, describing Airtel as one of modern India’s most loved and enduring brands. He will now lead marketing efforts for the telecommunications firm.

stories.title: DC Studios appoints Jeremy Latcham as president and CCO
stories.summary: Skydance Motion Picture Group has appointed former Marvel executive Jeremy Latcham as president and CCO of DC Studios, effective December 1. Latcham will oversee the studio's film, television and animation slate. He replaces James Gunn and Peter Safran, who are returning to their own creative work.

stories.title: Garage Worldwide names Siddharth Shah as executive creative director
stories.summary: Garage Worldwide has appointed Siddharth Shah as executive creative director. Based in Mumbai, Shah will lead the agency's creative output. He previously worked with agencies including FCB Ulka and BBH, and was part of the founding team at Spring Marketing Capital. He has worked on various major brands.

stories.title: Publicis and WPP trade barbs over global account wins
stories.summary: Publicis Groupe issued an open letter to WPP CEO Cindy Rose following comments she made during an earnings call regarding handshakes in account wins. Publicis argued the suggestion insulted client intelligence, claiming global firms do not hand over operations based on such gestures. The industry is currently watching.

stories.title: Tubi explores creator-led content strategies
stories.summary: Tubi is increasingly looking toward YouTube creators to fill its content slate. Creators like Nicole O’Rourke, who produces content for millions of subscribers, are shifting from user-generated platforms to more ambitious series. The full piece on how Tubi competes for creator talent is for subscribers to The Ankler.

stories.title: Entertainment spending shifts toward sports and creators
stories.summary: KPMG reports that global entertainment content spending reached $207 billion in 2025, up from $156 billion in 2021. The analysis shows a shift in budget allocation, with major platforms increasingly prioritizing sports and independent creators over traditional film and television production. The total spend continues to rise.

stories.title: Creators and studios seek cinema success
stories.summary: Top agents and industry executives report that the interest between creators and traditional studios is mutual. While creators can earn significant revenue through social platforms, many still view selling out theatres as a primary career goal. Studios are increasingly looking to capitalize on established online creator audiences.

stories.title: Entertainment 360 acquires influencer firm Brigade
stories.summary: Entertainment 360 has acquired the influencer marketing firm Brigade. The move is part of the company's broader expansion into the creator economy. Financial terms of the deal were not disclosed, but the acquisition signals a continued consolidation of talent management firms within the digital media space.

stories.title: YouTube and Creators HQ launch regional incubator
stories.summary: YouTube and UAE-based Creators HQ have launched an incubator to train over 1,000 creators across the Middle East and North Africa. The program aims to help participants earn commissions through YouTube Shopping. The initiative will provide members with industry expertise and connections to global platforms over two years.

stories.title: Hollywood looks to creators to de-risk film production
stories.summary: Speakers at the American Film Market summit noted that creator-led hits are reversing Hollywood's traditional production model. By building an audience online before financing a project, creators provide evidence of demand. The industry is now attempting to learn from this sequence to avoid cold marketing launches.

stories.title: Future of TV Briefing covers creator production processes
stories.summary: This week's Future of TV Briefing examines the production process of creator Grace Wells, who emphasizes extensive pre-production for branded video content. The briefing also tracks potential media probes and streaming industry developments. The full report is available to Digiday+ members via the weekly email series.

stories.title: YouTube expands into original programming
stories.summary: YouTube is increasingly positioning itself as a hub for original shows rather than just a platform for user-generated content. The shift reflects broader changes in how streaming platforms source and distribute entertainment. The full article on this strategic transition is available to registered users on the Mint website.

stories.title: Dubai launches YouTube Shopping program
stories.summary: Dubai has launched a program to assist 1,000 creators in earning commissions through YouTube Shopping. The initiative aims to support regional content creators in monetizing their product recommendations. Further details regarding the program's implementation and eligibility requirements are available on the Arabian Business website for verified users.

stories.title: Instagram tests long-form video incentives
stories.summary: Instagram is testing a new initiative offering selected creators between $50,000 and $500,000 to post long-form content. The platform is attempting to compete with YouTube, though it has yet to share a concrete advertising model. Creators are currently weighing discovery potential against the lack of guaranteed income.

stories.title: YouTube creator disparities highlighted
stories.summary: The landscape for YouTube creators remains uneven, with significant differences in reach and monetization potential across the platform. The full analysis regarding the current state of creator equity and industry trends is available on the Next in Media website for those who can access the content.

stories.title: Trust in creator brand disclosures remains low
stories.summary: A Morning Consult survey indicates that only 25 percent of U.S. adults believe creators consistently disclose brand deals. Older demographics are particularly skeptical, with 53 percent of Baby Boomers stating creators rarely or never disclose paid partnerships. The industry continues to navigate these challenges regarding audience trust.

stories.title: Zefr expands ad quality measurement to CapCut and TikTok
stories.summary: Zefr has extended its ad quality measurement services to include CapCut and TikTok's TopView ads. The company can now report on whether ads appear beside harmful content on these surfaces. The announcement coincided with a similar release from Integral Ad Science regarding TikTok's advertising inventory.

stories.title: Meta faces scrutiny over election moderation
stories.summary: Allegations have emerged regarding Meta's moderation policies during the Brazilian elections, specifically concerning foreign-funded ads and fake profiles. The company has recently signaled a shift toward deregulation, citing freedom of expression. The intersection of private technology interests and public political processes remains a subject of ongoing debate.

stories.title: Zefr expands media quality measurement to CapCut
stories.summary: Zefr is extending its AI-powered media quality measurement to CapCut and increasing its coverage across TikTok ad formats, including TopView and Search Ads. The company aims to provide advertisers with greater transparency into where their content appears. The expansion follows similar moves by other industry measurement providers.

stories.title: IAS adds media quality coverage for CapCut and TikTok
stories.summary: Integral Ad Science is bringing its Total Media Quality coverage to CapCut and TikTok advertising experiences. The integration aims to provide advertisers with brand safety and suitability insights across short-form video content. The company says the move helps brands navigate the complexities of modern social media environments.

stories.title: TikTok doubles AI video length in Symphony
stories.summary: TikTok has updated its Symphony creative suite, allowing advertisers to generate AI videos up to 30 seconds long, double the previous limit. The tool uses a new agent to build videos from prompts and brand data. Advertisers outside North America can now also purchase BytePlus tokens for access.

stories.title: Tokyo court dismisses Maezawa suit against Meta
stories.summary: The Tokyo District Court dismissed a lawsuit from entrepreneur Yusaku Maezawa against Meta regarding fraudulent investment ads. While the court acknowledged the ads infringed on his publicity rights, it found no platform liability. The ruling marks a judicial distinction between rights violations and the responsibility of social platforms.

stories.title: X introduces native video clipping tool
stories.summary: X has launched a video clipping feature that allows users to trim longer videos into shorter segments for posting. The tool includes a label linking back to the original content. The platform says the feature is designed to help influencers engage audiences and participate in its creator rewards program.

stories.title: X adds video clipping
stories.summary: Enable JavaScript and cookies to continue The option allows users to share shorter snippets of creator content while still giving credit and allowing both posters to earn monetary rewards. The full piece is for subscribers, and the headline is all that is public for now.

stories.title: Japan court dismisses suit against Meta over scam ads using billionaire’s likeness
stories.summary: TOKYO, Nov 10 , A Tokyo court dismissed today Japanese billionaire Yusaku Maezawa’s lawsuit against US tech giant Meta and its Japan unit over the use of his name and image in fraudulent investment ads on their platforms. Online fraudsters commonly use Maezawa’s name and

stories.title: Meta Pauses Its Updated Business And Ad Terms Due Nov. 20
stories.summary: Meta paused new ad and business terms scheduled to go into effect on Nov. 20. That leaves advertisers and other businesses using Meta’s services operating under existing terms. The pre-existing terms permit Meta to crawl content on advertiser websites for use such as “research and

stories.title: X Turns Video Clipping Into A Creator Economy Feature
stories.summary: Clipping someone else’s video on X used to require exactly the kind of workflow social platforms should have killed years ago. Download the video. Open another app. Trim the moment you want. Upload it again. Now X has made clipping native , and, more importantly,

stories.title: boost.ai launches Presis classification model
stories.summary: boost.ai has released Presis, a self-hosted language model designed to manage classification decisions for AI agents. The company claims the model is at least 2.5 times faster than its predecessors. It handles tasks like agent routing and safety checks for regulated industries during peak demand hours.

stories.title: Authenticx releases autonomous research agent
stories.summary: Authenticx has launched KBo Flow, an autonomous AI research agent for healthcare and pharmaceutical clients. The tool investigates patient interactions and recommends next steps without waiting for user prompts. It analyzes both structured and unstructured data to provide intelligence based on an organization’s specific goals and priorities.

stories.title: Bluehost debuts AI website builder
stories.summary: Bluehost has launched an AI Builder platform aimed at small businesses. The tool allows users to create websites and applications by describing their needs, removing the requirement for coding or technical expertise. The company says the platform combines conversational AI with hosting and 24/7 human support services.

stories.title: Influur updates influencer campaign tool
stories.summary: Influur has launched Pulse 2.0, an AI-powered platform for managing music influencer campaigns. Users can input objectives and budgets to have the tool identify creators and allocate spending. The company says the update replaces manual tasks like spreadsheet management and rate negotiation with a single prompt-based workflow.

stories.title: Tano raises $4 million for influencer deal agents
stories.summary: London-based startup Tano has raised $4 million in seed funding led by Cherry Ventures. The company uses AI agents to negotiate brand deals with creators, reporting 400,000 conversations per month. The startup aims to automate the manual outreach and negotiation process that currently defines influencer marketing.

stories.title: TikTok updates Symphony AI suite with new capabilities - Campaign Middle East
stories.summary: TikTok is giving advertisers more control over AI-generated video production, allowing them to create longer videos, use more reference materials and produce more consistent visuals. Back in June, TikTok introduced Symphony, an AI-powered creative production suite, designed to help brands, advertisers and agencies create content

stories.title: Zingtree launches agentic governance platform
stories.summary: Zingtree has introduced an orchestration platform for managing AI agents in regulated industries like healthcare and finance. The tool aims to help enterprises control costs and latency while maintaining compliance. Gartner predicts that 40% of enterprises will adopt such governance as AI agent usage continues to accelerate.

stories.title: Fullstory makes AI agents generally available
stories.summary: Fullstory has released its StoryAI Agents and Model Context Protocol to all customers. The tools allow teams to analyze customer behavioral data and automate workflows at scale. The company says the platform does not just report digital experiences but investigates and delivers answers to the appropriate human or agent.

stories.title: Cognitiv partners with FreeWheel for CTV access
stories.summary: Cognitiv has integrated with FreeWheel to provide advertisers with direct access to premium Connected TV inventory. The partnership allows Cognitiv’s deep learning models to bid on video opportunities in real time. The company says the move simplifies programmatic buying in an increasingly critical advertising channel.

stories.title: GOcxm launches Signal IQ to connect marketing data
stories.summary: GOcxm has launched Signal IQ, an AI system designed to connect signals across brand, shopper, and trade marketing. The company claims the platform answers critical business questions and tells teams what to change to improve results. It aims to unify functions currently managed through separate systems.

stories.title: Ogilvy and CAA launch ECHO for AI-generated content
stories.summary: Ogilvy and CAA have launched ECHO, a platform that turns single celebrity shoots into multiple campaign assets. Developed by Carol Reed, the system uses verified talent scans to scale creative content. The platform aims to protect talent rights while addressing growing industry concerns regarding unauthorised synthetic media.

stories.title: Ogilvy platform ECHO aims to scale celebrity content
stories.summary: Ogilvy and CAA are launching ECHO to turn single celebrity shoots into real-time creative content systems. The platform claims to protect artists while setting storytellers free through machine-enforceable contract protections. It uses AI to generate localised assets while maintaining human-led creative oversight for global brands.

research.title: Effective and Efficient Attributed Hypergraph Embedding on Nodes and Hyperedges
research.summary: Announce Type: replace Abstract: An attributed hypergraph comprises nodes with attributes and hyperedges that connect varying numbers of nodes. Attributed hypergraph node and hyperedge embedding (AHNEE) maps nodes and hyperedges to compact vectors for use in important tasks such as. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: SeqFold: Timestamp-Addressable Compressed States for User Action Sequence Backbones
research.summary: Announce Type: cross Abstract: Existing sequential user modeling methods mainly focus on improving the backbone encoder or learning task-specific user representations for a single prediction objective. We instead study how to export the multi-layer user states of a frozen long-history. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Using LLM Agents to Evaluate Prosocial Interventions on Social Media Platforms
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Social media platforms are a primary source of information for many users. Although research explores various interventions to promote prosocial content or demote harmful content on platforms, there are few systematic methods for evaluating competing intervention. Preprint, not peer reviewed.
